statement:
In a magma \(M = (M, \cdot)\) with equality \(\approx\), the non-divisibility relation \(
mid\) (where \(x 
mid y\) means no element \(q\) satisfies \(q \cdot x \approx y\)) is invariant under substitution of equal elements in each argument: whenever \(x \approx y\), \(x 
mid z\) implies \(y 
mid z\), and \(z 
mid x\) implies \(z 
mid y\). In other words, \(
mid\) respects \(\approx\) on both its right and left arguments.
